caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a cylindrical wooden handle, colored in medium to dark brown tones with visible wood grain textures. Attached to the handle is a metal component comprising two circular, spoked wheels with a supporting arm connecting the handle to the center of the wheels. The wheels and metal parts are rendered in shades of dark brown and gray, depicting a metallic texture with some shading to suggest depth and dimensionality. There are no other objects, lines, or decorations present in the drawing, and the composition is simple with the object positioned vertically in the center of the image.
title: Blacksmith's Measuring Wheel
